jobs.description:
**Role: SAP IS\-U Solution Architect/Lead** 




**Location: Remote** 




**Duration: Long Term** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 We are seeking an experienced SAP IS\-U Solution Architect with 15\+ years of experience in Utilities (Gas, Electricity, or Water) to lead end\-to\-end solution architecture and design governance. The role involves translating business requirements into scalable SAP IS\-U solutions, reviewing and assuring service provider design deliverables, and ensuring alignment with business strategy, enterprise architecture standards, and SAP Clean Core principles. The candidate will drive business process transformation by leveraging standard SAP capabilities, create and maintain architecture artifacts, lead impact assessments for change requests, and provide architectural guidance to Program Management Teams and Change Control Boards. The architect will participate in Architecture Review Boards and Design Authority forums, make key design decisions, and ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems. Strong expertise in SAP Utilities solutions including CRM, CCS, IS\-U Billing \& Invoicing, EDM, Device Management, and FI\-CA is required, along with proven experience delivering end\-to\-end SAP IS\-U implementations. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of IS\-U data design, solution architecture documentation, governance standards, and the ability to convert business requirements into functional designs while assessing regulatory and business changes to drive value for the organization.

**Job Summary**


This hybrid role seeks a Functional Lead with 9\-13 years of experience in SAP and SAP IS Utilities FICA to drive functional design and delivery for Energy and Utilities client. The candidate will translate business needs into robust SAP solutions that enhance operational reliability regulatory compliance and sustainable energy outcomes while collaborating closely with cross functional teams in a day shift model.


Lead the design and implementation of SAP FICA solutions, ensuring they meet business requirements and industry best practices.  

* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to define project scopes, goals, and deliverables.
* Conduct detailed requirement analysis and create functional specifications for SAP FICA\-Utilities projects.


\- Oversee the integration of SAP FICA with other SAP modules and third\-party systems to ensure seamless operations. \- Provide expert guidance on SAP FICA configuration, customization, and optimization.  

* Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets to ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery.
* Facilitate training sessions and workshops for end\-users and team members on SAP FICA functionalities.
* Stay abreast of the latest SAP FICA developments and industry trends to recommend improvements and innovations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory, security, and data privacy standards within the SAP FICA domain.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system performance and user satisfaction Must have extensive experience SAP\-FICA\-Utilities.


\- Proven track record in the Utilities, Retail, and Customer Services domains. \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Experience in SAP SAP ISUtilities FICA BRF\+ is highly desirable.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Commitment to delivering high\-quality solutions that make a positive impact on the business


  

**Qualifications*** Require strong hands on experience in SAP IS Utilities FICA including configuration of device categories registers installation structures move in and move out processes and device events for complex utility environments.
* Require proven exposure to engineering and construction business processes such as project execution asset commissioning material tracking and field work management implemented within or integrated with SAP.
* Require experience working with energy trading operations where device and metering data supports trade capture balancing settlement and regulatory reporting within SAP or connected applications.
* Require demonstrated capability to design and test end to end SAP scenarios that span device management billing finance and operations to ensure process integrity and data consistency.
* Require strong proficiency in writing functional specifications test scenarios and training materials that clearly explain SAP behavior to both technical and non technical audiences.
* Require practical experience operating in hybrid work models and collaborating with distributed teams using remote collaboration tools while maintaining high service quality in a day shift schedule.
* Nice to have experience with adjacent SAP utilities components such as customer service billing work management or plant maintenance that interact with device data for holistic solution delivery.
* Nice to have experience with regulatory or industry standards in utilities and energy trading where accurate metering device status and asset records play a central role in compliance and audit readiness.
* Nice to have exposure to analytics or reporting tools connected to SAP that leverage device and metering data for performance dashboards predictive maintenance and operational insights.

**Certifications Required**


Preferred SAP certification in SAP IS Utilities or SAP S4HANA Utilities or related SAP functional modules.

jobs.title: SAP FICO Consultant (BRIM, FICA, RAR)
jobs.description:
**SAP FICO Consultant (BRIM, FICA, RAR)** 




**Sunnyvale, CA – (Onsite)** 




**W2 Contract/ Fulltime (Permanent)** 




  





**Job Description:**




  





**Experience:**
 Minimum 12\+ years of Experience as a SAP FICO Consultant
 



  





**Core Skills:**



* **SAP Modules:** 
 FICO, BRIM, FICA, RAR, MM, SD, PP
* **SAP Processes \& Configuration:** 
 Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Bank Accounting (BA), Fixed Assets, Depreciation, Acquisition, Retirement, Cost Centre Accounting (CCA), Profit Centre Accounting (PCA), Product Costing, Company Codes, Controlling Areas, Profit Centres, Cost Centres, Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting
* **SAP Implementation \& Project Management:** 
 ERP solutions, Designing, Implementing, Deploying, Validating report requirements, Validating changes, Customizing, Training end\-users, Solution stability, Data evaluation, Data movement, Data exclusion, Data historicization, Gap analysis ("As\-Is" to "To\-Be"), Transition Service Agreement (TSA), Data mapping, Data separation, Data neutralization, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Pre\-cutover reconciliations, Post\-cutover reconciliations, End\-to\-end data flow
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Finance, Financial Integrity, Data Privacy Regulations



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Design, implement, and deploy SAP\-based ERP solutions for client.
* Validate report requirements, changes, and customization.
* Provide training to end\-users ensuring solution stability.
* Work closely with client Finance team to sort day\-to\-day queries.
* Evaluate existing SAP data to determine what needs to be moved, excluded, or historicized, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations.
* Work with senior leadership to design the new company code structure, chart of accounts, and financial reporting requirements.
* Identify gaps between the "As\-Is" (current) process in the parent company and the "To\-Be" process required for the separated entity.
* Assist in defining the Transition Service Agreement (TSA) to ensure a smooth, compliant handover from the seller to the buyer.
* Configure new Company Codes, Controlling Areas, Profit Centres, and Cost Centres in the new SAP instance.
* Configure Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Bank Accounting (BA) tailored to the new entity’s operations.
* Manage the separation of fixed assets, including depreciation, acquisition, and retirement data.
* Configure Cost Centre Accounting (CCA), Profit Centre Accounting (PCA), and Product Costing.
* Map financial data from the source to the target environment.
* Remove or neutralize data related to business units not involved in the carve\-out.
* Conduct System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support to ensure the accuracy of carved\-out financial data and processes.
* Perform pre\- and post\-cutover reconciliations to ensure financial integrity between the old and new systems.
* Collaborate with MM (Materials Management), SD (Sales \& Distribution), and PP (Production Planning) teams to ensure seamless end\-to\-end data flow.

Role Description:

The Financial Systems team provides technology expertise to the finance department and is responsible for SAP, HANA, and connected 3rd party systems at Booking.com. We want to change the way people work with SAP, by building a finance application platform that supports simplification of business processes, and empowers the finance community with better financial insights.


We run our SAP environment on HANA and in February 2016 we migrated to Simple Finance. In 2019 we started our journey to S4 HANA.

As a FICA Specialist You will utilize your knowledge of SAP FICO and FICA/FICAx to design solutions which meet business objectives and goals.


You will participate in the development of solution design documents, functional design documents, configurational rationale, testing and deployment.


You will partner with business owners and digital teams to identify opportunities for improvement and offer up appropriate solution designs to meet business objectives


Through your experience of FICA/FICAx, you will translate business requirements into system configuration which meet business requirements.


You will have deep experience with the integration of FICA/FICAx to SAP FICO, Account Determination and Revenue Recognition.


This role involves extensive daily interaction with functional specialists, developers in all finance and IT departments in Booking.com. It is essential that you have a strong understanding of finance processes and integration with legacy systems and you have strong verbal/written communication and presentation skills in English.


Due to the rapid and continuous growth of the organization, the tasks and duties of this role may evolve over time. You will be keen to develop and grow within the role and to take on additional challenges and responsibilities as they occur.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Full ownership of projects and quality of changes, from planning, communication, coordination, compliance aspects, customization and go\-live hypercare;
* Analytical thinking;
* Providing scalable and innovative solutions;
* Ability to take fast decisions in a very dynamic environment, with some level of uncertainty;
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities (processes, people) to improve project delivery and/or development methodologies;
* Training of key users and key user support.Analyzing issues and changes;

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as FI, CRM or Billing—depending on the industry—and manage integrations with external systems like payment gateways, banks, or third\-party collection tools.
* Good knowledge of Master Data, Transactional data, Invoicing \- B2B/B2C, Sub\-ledger Accounting, Dunning, Clearing, Payment Processing, Account determination, Close, FI Integration and Correspondence framework.

* Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
* Organized, flexible, proactive and result oriented.
